typography.installation_instructions: Import fonts via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@400;700&family=Manrope:wght@300;400;600;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400&display=swap');

usage_rules.h1: Cinzel font-bold text-5xl md:text-7xl tracking-tighter text-gold-grad
usage_rules.h2: Cinzel font-bold text-3xl md:text-4xl tracking-tight text-white/90
usage_rules.h3: Manrope font-semibold text-xl tracking-wide uppercase text-gold-500
usage_rules.data_labels: Manrope font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-zinc-500

grids.catalog: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-8

buttons.primary: bg-gold-500 text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-widest hover:bg-gold-400 transition-all duration-300 px-8 py-4 rounded-sm hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(212,175,55,0.3)]
buttons.secondary: border border-zinc-700 text-zinc-300 hover:border-gold-500 hover:text-gold-500 uppercase tracking-widest transition-all px-8 py-4 rounded-sm

product_card.style: bg-charcoal border border-white/5 hover:border-gold-500/50 transition-all duration-500 group relative overflow-hidden
product_card.image_container: aspect-[4/5] overflow-hidden grayscale-[20%] group-hover:grayscale-0 transition-all duration-700
product_card.content: p-6 bg-gradient-to-t from-black via-black/80 to-transparent absolute bottom-0 w-full

inputs.style: bg-zinc-900/50 border border-zinc-800 focus:border-gold-500 text-white placeholder-zinc-600 rounded-none h-12 px-4 transition-colors

navigation.bar: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/5 h-20 flex items-center justify-between px-6 md:px-12

universal_guidelines.visual_hierarchy: Content is King. Use size and contrast to guide the eye. Gold is for action/highlight only.
universal_guidelines.interactions: All interactables must have a hover state. Use duration-300 for smooth transitions.
universal_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure text contrast is at least 4.5:1. Use ARIA labels on icon buttons.
universal_guidelines.dark_mode_rule: Avoid pure black #000000 on cards. Use #0A0A0A or #121212 to reduce eye strain and allow shadows to be visible.
universal_guidelines.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: STEP 1: Install fonts in index.css using the @import provided.
STEP 2: Update tailwind.config.js with the custom colors (obsidian, gold) and font families.
STEP 3: Create the Layout component with the sticky glass header.
STEP 4: Build the 'StrainCard' component using the specified image aspect ratio and overlay gradient.
STEP 5: Implement the Catalog page with the sidebar filter (left) and product grid (right).
STEP 6: Ensure all prices are shown as tiers ($ / $$ / $$$) not numbers.
STEP 7: Use the provided Unsplash URLs for the mock data seed.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use standard Shadcn cards. Build custom <div> based cards with border-white/10 to match the luxury aesthetic.
